texte.Cliquez sur chaque carte pour déplier le: Click each card to expand the detail: concrete examples, actual applicability, exact legal obligation and practical advice. Once a system has been identified, use the button at the bottom of the page to send it directly to the AI Act simulator.
texte.Cliquez sur les # cartes (Explorer, Comp: Click the # cards (Explore, Compare, Simulate) to go directly to the corresponding tools. The lists on the right are sorted by score and link to the detailed profiles.
texte.Cliquez sur une cellule pour faire défil: Click a cell to cycle through its status. Change sector to see the sector-specific roles and processes appear (Sector badge). The 🤖 button generates a complete AI analysis document of your matrix.
texte.Cliquez sur une ligne pour ouvrir le sui: Click a row to open the client’s detailed follow-up.
texte.Cliquez sur « Recalculer » après chaque: Click “Recalculate” after each assessment campaign. Each framework links to its modules: deal with the lowest component first — it is the one pulling the index down.
texte.Cliquez un module pour ouvrir sa fiche c: Click a module to open its full details: objectives, detailed programme, articles covered, quiz and target certification.
texte.Cliquez une carte pour être redirigé dir: Click a card to be taken directly to the tool that generates this document, with your actual data already loaded.
texte.Cliquez une icône dans la grille ou un s: Click an icon in the grid or a system in the critical zone to open its record directly in the AI register.
texte.Cliquez une ligne pour revenir directeme: Click a row to go straight back to the corresponding tool (Simulator or Audit). Useful for tracking your progress over time.

texte.Cochez ce que vous faites réellement, pa: Tick what you actually do, not what your brochure says. If the verdict is “reclassified as a manufacturer” or “integrator”, read the “extent” line: it says whether you answer for the part you modified or for the entire product, and it is that line which decides the scale of the technical documentation to produce. The path followed is displayed under the verdict: it serves to challenge it.
texte.Cochez les modules à inclure et ordonnez: Tick the modules to include and put them in order. The path will guide you from one module to the next up to the cost and the summary.

texte.Commencez ici, avant de rouvrir le moind: Start here, before reopening any document.
texte.Commencez ici, avant d’ouvrir le moindre: Start here, before opening any questionnaire.
texte.Commencez par #, le domaine d’applicatio: Start with #, the scope: it is the most structuring decision of the entire certification, because everything not excluded in writing will be audited. A broad scope reassures the client and doubles the bill; a narrow scope passes the audit and proves nothing to anyone. Then check #, planning of changes: it is the only clause that the # edition added to the body of the standard.
texte.Commencez par #, le périmètre : tout ce: Start with #, the scope: everything not excluded in writing will be audited, and a vague scope is the leading cause of cost overruns in a certification audit. Then move on to the clauses marked “specific to AI”, which carry the AI policy, the risk assessment and the impact assessment. The “shareable” clauses are rated quickly if you are already certified elsewhere — you have them.
texte.Commencez par b) et d). La gestion des i: Start with b) and d). Incident handling drives the clock of Article #; supply chain security is the measure that Article #(#) details the most — it requires taking into account the vulnerabilities SPECIFIC to each direct supplier, which a generic supplier policy does not do. Measure e), vulnerability handling and disclosure, largely overlaps with Annex I of the CRA: if you also manufacture a product, the work is done once.
texte.Commencez par la fin : regardez ce qui f: Start at the end: look at what makes each of the two stages fail.
texte.Commencez par la politique : sans elle,: Start with the policy: without it, code review has no criterion and comes down to an opinion.
texte.Commencez par le circuit d’un usage nouv: Start with the workflow for a new use: it is what reveals the decisions nobody takes ownership of.
texte.Commencez par le produit dont vous doute: Start with the product you have doubts about, not the simplest one. If you place it in class I, the “harmonised standards applied in full” box decides everything: ticked, you remain under internal control; unticked, you switch to the notified body. It is the costliest switch in the text, and it happens there. Partly applied, or not yet published, count as not applied.
texte.Commencez par le périmètre, pas par l'an: Start with the scope, not the analysis. Objective # requires ALL systems to be covered, and only admits an exclusion if a risk analysis shows the absence of exposure to the three named risks — interruption, disclosure, alteration. The framework explicitly closes the door to circumvention: the presence of security measures is not a justification. Then check your two routes of evidence: a certified ISO/IEC #:# ISMS, bounded by its certification scope, and a PACS qualified by ANSSI, bounded by the follow-up of the treatment plan.
texte.Commencez par le rang #. Ne descendez au: Start with rank #. Only go down to rank # once the blockers have been lifted.
texte.Commencez par les quatre exclusions de l: Start with the four exclusions of Article #(#): they are not assessed, they are established, and any one of them is enough to close the question. A provider that is intra-group, or that only serves entities active in a single Member State, cannot be designated, whatever its market share. Then fill in the measured shares.
Start with the four exclusions of Article #(#): a single one is enough to close the question.
texte.Commencez par les traitements les plus s: Start with the most sensitive or large-scale processing activities.
texte.Commencez toujours par le registre des t: Always start with the records of processing activities: without them, the other modules have nothing to process. Add your processing activities, then let the other pages derive from them.

Compare with the AI Act regime.

texte.Comparez ce que pèse votre parc déclaré: Compare what your declared estate weighs with what the platform itself weighs, metered call by call.
texte.Comparez ce que vous venez de renseigner: Compare what you have just filled in with the body of the standard.
texte.Comparez jusqu’à quatre cadres nationaux: Compare up to four national frameworks on the dimensions that decide your offering.
texte.Comparez jusqu’à quatre juridictions sur: Compare up to four jurisdictions on the six regulatory dimensions, side by side rather than one after the other.
texte.Comparez les sites entre eux plutôt que: Compare the sites with one another rather than reading a total: it is the gap that shows where to act.
texte.Comparez maturité, investissement et ris: Compare your sector’s AI maturity, investment and risk.
texte.Comparez votre lecture à l’empreinte env: Compare your reading with the environmental footprint of the mapped estate: electricity, CO₂e, amortised manufacturing, water.
texte.Comparez votre profil sur # dimensions (: Compare your profile on # dimensions (governance, security, fundamental rights…) with the sector average.
texte.Comparez à densité et à mode de refroidi: Compare at comparable density and cooling method: a once-through water site and a closed-loop site cannot be compared on water.
texte.Compilation datée du cabinet — communiqu: Dated compilation by the firm — press releases and decisions of authorities
texte.Complète votre AIPD existante — la FRIA: Complements your existing DPIA — the FRIA covers angles that the GDPR alone does not address (bias, algorithmic discrimination).
texte.Complémentaire de l’étape maturité de la: Complementary to the maturity step of the mapping.
texte.Complémentaire à la Cartographie (qui es: Complementary to the Mapping (which is quantitative): here you will find the strategic context and the key instruments of each bloc.
texte.Comportement normal et attendu du middle: Normal and expected behaviour of the anti-scraping middleware (app.py, function is_bot_blocked). A request whose User-Agent matches a generic HTTP client (e.g. Go-http-client, curl, python-requests) is logged and blocked automatically. Example observed: IP #.x.x.x (Google Cloud Platform range), UA Go-http-client/# -- probably a third-party scanner or monitoring bot, unrelated to Render itself. Action required: none, unless the volume of blocks becomes abnormally high (aggressive scan) or the attempts specifically target sensitive routes (/api/registre, forms). Not to be confused with Render’s internal health checks (IP #, already whitelisted in the middleware).
texte.Comprehension des sorties du systeme par: Understanding of the system’s outputs by the supervisors (Art. #(#)(b))
texte.Comprendre l'architecture du règlement (: Understand the architecture of Regulation (EU) #/#, identify the roles and place the organisation in the timetable.
texte.Comprendre la norme, structurer un SMIA: Understand the standard, structure an AIMS and prepare for certification.
texte.Comprendre la structure d un système de: Understand the structure of an AI management system (AIMS) under ISO/IEC #:#
texte.Comprendre le champ d application et la: Understand the scope and the extraterritorial reach of Regulation (EU) #/#
texte.Comprendre les exigences de sécurité app: Understand the security requirements applicable to AI systems (Art. # EU AI Act)
texte.Compteur en temps réel de l’empreinte du: Real-time counter of the footprint of the site, the platform and the language models used, based on actual use: tokens consumed, latency, pages served. Three calculation methods are run in parallel.
texte.Comptez les exigences non couvertes : ce: Count the requirements not covered: they are what opens the heavy tier.
texte.Comptez les produits qui passent par un: Count the products that go through a notified body.
texte.Concentration lue sur la carte : plusieu: Concentration read on the map: several offtakers may depend on the same connection point. No actuarial model is applied.
texte.Concentrez-vous d’abord sur # à # cas tr: Focus first on # to # cross-functional cases with a quick return.
texte.Concentrez-vous sur le pilier Confidenti: Focus on the Confidentiality & Security pillar — where do you really stand?
texte.Concevoir des interfaces permettant la s: Design interfaces that enable effective oversight
texte.Concilier innovation et protection des d: Reconcile innovation and data protection across the entire life cycle of an AI system.
texte.Conditions imposées (si autorisation sou: Conditions imposed (if authorised subject to conditions)
texte.Conduire et formaliser l'analyse d'impac: Conduct and formalise the impact assessment provided for in Article #.
texte.Conduisez la FRIA exigée pour certains s: Conduct the FRIA required for certain high-risk systems.
texte.Conduisez l’évaluation d’impact sur les: Conduct the fundamental rights impact assessment if the classification requires it (art. #).
texte.Conduite autonome et gestion du trafic =: Autonomous driving and traffic management = high-risk. Maximum robustness and safety. Sector type-approval (EASA for aviation, UNECE for automotive).
texte.Conduite à tenir en cas de violation de: What to do in the event of a personal data breach

texte.Confirmer la réception de chaque notific: Confirm receipt of each notification without delay

texte.Consentement, contrat, obligation légale: Consent, contract, legal obligation, legitimate interest…

texte.Conserver la preuve d'enregistrement dan: Keep the proof of registration in the compliance file
texte.Conserver la preuve de chaque revue huma: Keep evidence of each human review: without a trace, the intervention is deemed absent
texte.Conserver les CGU et garanties du fourni: Keep the terms of use and guarantees of the API provider — useful in the event of a substantial modification (Art. #).
texte.Conservez les preuves dans la Base de co: Keep the evidence in the Knowledge base for immediate traceability.
texte.Conservez une copie datée de l’indice au: Keep a dated copy of the index at the time of signature: it is the baseline record you will be able to rely on.
texte.Conservez une trace datée de ce qui est: Keep a dated record of what is displayed: the evidence counts as much as the practice.
texte.Conservons-nous les preuves de la logiqu: Do we keep evidence of the logic of the arrangement and of the human review?
texte.Consignez chaque cotation avec sa date e: Record each rating with its date and its evidence.
texte.Consignez chaque vérification, produit p: Record each check, product by product, with its date.
texte.Consolidation des résultats des étapes p: Consolidation of the results of the previous steps; no new calculation.
texte.Consolide les briques du dispositif — re: Consolidates the building blocks of the framework — records, mapping, DPIA, privacy by design, documentation, awareness — into a global index with points of attention.
texte.Consolide vos évaluations des trois cadr: Consolidates your assessments of the three frameworks into a single index, intended for an executive committee. It is a steering and dialogue instrument, not an attestation of compliance.
texte.Consolidez IA Act, RGPD et ISO/IEC # en: Consolidate the AI Act, the GDPR and ISO/IEC # into a single view before freezing the EU declaration of conformity.
texte.Consolidez le classement, l’empreinte et: Consolidate the ranking, the footprint and the legal reservations into an executive view.
texte.Constats des étapes précédentes, rattach: Findings of the previous steps, linked to version #-#-a of the framework
Findings of the previous steps, linked to the version of the framework used

texte.Constituez le dossier technique : archit: Build the technical file: architecture, training and validation data, measured performance, known limitations, human oversight measures.
